title: Thu 29 Oct · Full body
notes: First one in Hevy. Pick weights you could do 2–3 more reps with; I'll set them from here next time. Legs stay moderate: if your back or legs tighten, skip the rest of that exercise.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.note: One arm, other hand on a bench or chair so your back is supported.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: Floor press is fine if there's no bench.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.note: Bodyweight. Squeeze at the top for a second.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: Seated if you have a chair with a back.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.note: Slow. Low back stays flat on the floor.
